ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark grey to black) ventral surface with approximately 5-8% high-intensity (white) localized pixel clusters forming circular scars and mottling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary dark pigmentation field. A concentrated region of high-intensity white mottling is visible on the mid-left lobe. Multiple discrete white circular rings and semi-circles are distributed across both lobes, with higher density at the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow U-shaped central depression with a wide vertex angle (~140-150 degrees) and low depth relative to lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serrations along the trailing edge; low-amplitude variations near the notch, transitioning to high-amplitude, jagged peaks and valleys at the lateral lobe tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the trailing edges of both the left and right lobes, tapering significantly toward the outer terminals.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous high-contrast white circular and elliptical rings (approx. 10-30 pixels in diameter) distributed across both lobes, including a dense cluster of overlapping rings at the far right distal tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring (rosettes) across the entire visible ventral fluke surface, likely resulting from barnacle colonization.
